subject: Invoice #204 - campus cleaning July
body:
Good afternoon,

Please find attached invoice #204 for cleaning services at the Northside campus for July, total $880.00 inc GST, payment due within 14 days. Bank details are on the invoice. This is our first invoice under the new agreement — let me know if your accounts team needs anything set up on your end.

Thanks,
Priya
Sparkle Cleaning QLD
